description: We are a passionate and ambitious team of students from the UAE interested in space, science, technology, and innovation. Our team brings together creativity, problem-solving, leadership, and a strong passion for learning. We aim to use science, AI, engineering, and technology to develop innovative solutions to real-world challenges.
summary:
Our project is an interactive educational game where players take on the role of an explorer responsible for keeping a colony on Mars safe and running.
We developed a game with eight missions where players drive a rover, explore the Martian surface, collect minerals, repair important systems, and deal with challenges such as dust storms, power shortages, and water problems. Players must make decisions and solve engineering problems to help the colony survive.
Our game addresses the challenge by using NASA's Mars exploration knowledge to turn real scientific and engineering problems into fun, interactive activities. Instead of just reading about Mars, players can experience some of the difficulties astronauts and engineers might face while living there.
We believe this project is important because it makes space science easier to understand, especially for students. It also encourages young people to become interested in space exploration and problem-solving while having fun.
details:
Mars Guardians is an educational game where players drive a rover, explore Mars, collect minerals, and complete eight missions to keep a Mars colony alive. Players face challenges like dust storms, power shortages, and water problems while managing important resources.

We developed the game using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and used NASA resources to make it connected to real Mars exploration. The game runs directly in a web browser without installing anything.

What makes our project different is that students can learn about Mars by playing and solving problems instead of just reading information. We focused on making the game fun, easy to use, and educational.

Our goal is to help students understand the challenges of living on Mars and encourage them to become more interested in space, science, and engineering.
